data.text:
Rack A sensor S1 remains stuck at 27.19C - flat for 120+ min, so Rack A has no temperature coverage. Other sensors look normal and cannot prove Rack A is safe.

Physics fit now favors a vent blockage in Rack A (0.60) / Rack B (0.38), p_fault 0.98, but forecasts no limit breach in 60-90 min, margin about -5.6C. Regression estimate of hidden zones is unreliable with S1 flat.

I tested dispatch_human_check and clear_vent rackA: both show same as do-nothing in forecast, so no new drastic action is justified and gate would refuse. A human inspection/repair was already approved earlier to restore coverage and inspect for blockage - that is inspection/repair in the simulation, not proven prevention.

Info notice sent. Uncertain due to blind zone - keep monitoring, re-diagnose if S2/S3/M1/M2 drift or S1 recovers.
